text:
Ravi Shah: hey team - first day here! quick blockers: i get a 403 when opening the "Redwood / Product UI" Figma file and i found two notion pages called 'roadmap' - which one is authoritative? also would love pointers on the research playbook and how to join upcoming user interviews
Elena Morales: welcome Ravi!! Figma email? i'll add you to the design org and invite you to the file. canonical roadmap is Notion > Product > Roadmap (we have a live page, the older one is archived)
Ravi Shah: ravi.shah@redwood.ai thanks Elena
design-ops-bot: Hi Ravi 44b Onboarding checklist (short): 1) Request Figma access 2) Join #product-sync & #design-ops 3) Read Product > Roadmap (Notion - Live) 4) Review Research Playbook 5) Request Maze/Lookback seats if needed. Link: https://notion.redwood.ai/s/onboarding-product
Elena Morales: invite sent, you should see an email from Figma. if it's still blocked try signing out/in or accept from the invite email.
Casey Wu: hey Ravi - Research Playbook lives in Notion under Product > Research. we keep discussion guide templates, consent language, recruiting forms, and a board for open studies. recruiting triage happens on Thursdays at 10am PT and external panels go through design-ops
Ravi Shah: awesome - can i shadow a session this week? i'd like to see a moderated usability interview to learn the script and note-taking flow
Mina Park: welcome! tag @Casey and i'll add you as an observer to Friday's 11am slot (light schedule this week). also we push short synth notes to the research page and post summaries in #product-research
Ravi Shah: perfect. quick technical q: where are design tokens stored and who approves token publishes? i want to avoid accidentally changing global spacing tokens
Elena Morales: tokens live in the design system Figma file and we mirror a tokens doc in Notion. small local edits are fine in a feature file, but any publish to the production library needs eng-platform approval. process: update changelog, run visual diffs, open PR in design-system repo, tag @platform-team and schedule a 15m review
Casey Wu: we also have a short checklist on the tokens Notion page: update migration notes, bump version, and add a short screenshot showing diffs. breaking renames require a migration RFC in the design-system repo
Ravi Shah: who should i ping for Maze / Lookback seats and for the research calendar invite?
design-ops-bot: Maze seat requests -> design-ops form: https://forms.redwood.ai/maze-request. Lookback access -> Product > Research Playbook (request link). Research calendar is shared GCal "Product Research" - request access via design-ops
Mina Park: i'll DM you the Maze form and add you to the research calendar. also we'll assign a pairing buddy for the first two weeks - i'll set that up after lunch
Ravi Shah: thanks all - invite came through and i can open the figma now 389 excited to start pairing and shadow research. i'll work through the checklist tonight and ping if anything else blocks :)
